summary: Part 3 of the 4.0 Orders App (TBU) seller training (07:56 to 12:07). Covers the Tracking ID field and tracking label link, the courier-data check that flags late orders (trainer's 48-hour rule), the order timeline and shipment logs, the first-step availability confirmation, the 5% charge the trainer mentions for cancellation, the Saudi tracking-ID step, the Request Revibe workflow, the Invoices page, the Payment Tool, and a closing note on the score KPIs. The item title is marked TBU, so dates and figures are 2024-2025 examples and need checking. All 32 frames listed in the pack were opened with Read. Several frame citations in the pack were wrong and are corrected below.

asr_fixes.basis: Screen shows 'Request Revibe' and 'Revibe Comments' (t00660.jpg, t00664.jpg).
Screen shows the Revibe brand and 'Request Revibe' fields (t00660.jpg); same term as 10:58.

unclear.issue: The sentence ends 'shipped on time or Here'. The word after 'or' cannot be made out, so the comparison the on-time check uses (for example, not on time) is not stated.

The trainer says a small delay can appear in the app (09:10), then says 'the shipping date will be always accurate' (09:17). The second line may mean 'will not always be accurate'. Not stated as a fact.

The trainer says to confirm availability for all orders, but no frame shows the confirm action being clicked. Availability Status already reads 'Confirmed' on an order that is still at quality check (t00476.jpg).

Cancellation charge: the base the 5% applies to, the currency, and how an order is cancelled in the app are not shown. The Cancel button in t00480.jpg is the edit-panel Cancel, not an order-cancellation action. Earlier (04:55-05:02) the trainer ties the 5% charge to marking an order unavailable, with a cost example of 902 (the Actual Cost of 61021-1 in t00660.jpg is 902). Whether the trigger is cancelling or marking unavailable is not settled here. The currency word spoken at 05:09 is garbled ('46 DRAMs').
The Request Revibe dropdown (t00664.jpg) lists 'String' and 'Confirmed' as options. The trainer names neither, and 'String' looks like a placeholder. Only the other options are stated as facts.
The courier company providing the data for UAE, Saudi Arabia and South Africa is not named at this point, and the video does not say how the courier link is set up.

Order Timeline in t00557.jpg shows Delivered Date '-', while the Shipment Status Logs for the same order in t00530.jpg show 'Delivered at 10 Dec 2024 3:05 PM'. The two screens disagree and the video does not explain it.
The example shipping date of 10 December is hypothetical. It is not the date shown on screen for the example order (9 Dec 2024), so the example must not be read as a real order.

The trainer's word for the shipment KPI is spoken as 'non-time shipment ratio'. No screen shows the KPI name, so the exact name and any 'on-time' reading are not confirmed. The four KPIs are not named, no formulas or targets are given, and 'which is very high' is not tied to a target.
The 'WH' column (numbers such as 13, 5, 2 and 272) and the cut-off 'Delivery S' column are not explained in the video.

outdated.signal: The item title is marked 'TBU (to be updated)'. This marker comes from the item title, not from speech or screen. Treat every screen, rule and number in this part as possibly out of date until confirmed.
The worked example is order 53156-1, confirmed 7 Dec 2024 and shipped 9 Dec 2024, with payment logged 17 Dec 2024. These are historical examples.
The 5% cancellation charge (10:36) and the 48-hour late threshold (09:38, 07:04) are stated only in speech in a TBU video. Confirm the current values before relying on them.
Invoice rows (dated 07/03/2025 to 25/03/2025) and the Payment Tool figure Total Payable 1042 (order SA-54831-1 confirmed 18/02/2025) are snapshots from earlier data, not current balances.
The score and its four KPIs are described without names or values, and the video is flagged TBU. The set may have changed.
